verdict.rationale: Together's docs say developers can "call chat, image, audio, embedding, and more through one API". Image generation is documented in depth, including text-to-image, parameters such as negative_prompt and guidance_scale, and image editing with reference images. Video generation from text, image, keyframe and audio inputs is also documented, all on the same serverless platform. missing for 10: dedicated documentation of vision (image-understanding) models, detail on audio models (speech-to-text/text-to-speech) beyond a one-line mention, independent or hands-on corroboration.
